title: Forms Technology And Generate Mode
description: Introduce forms technology (declarative form data, question kinds, multi-step builder playground) and flow Generate mode where input widgets become forms and generations are saved submissions evaluated through the worker pipeline. Extend ui with Catalogue, cross-container tree reorder, and Field primitives.
summary: Refactored forms playground to use framework side-panel infrastructure (Workbench: Hierarchy + Catalogue tabs; Details: Inspection tab) instead of duplicating hierarchy/catalogue/inspector inside FormBuilder. FormBuilder and FormsBuilderSurfaceHost now render FormRenderer only; tree builders, drag controllers, and controller commands live in forms/play; playground renderer wires PureSidePanelTabDefinition panels matching flow/shooting pattern. Verified in browser on port 6062: side panels show correct trees, center windows show form preview only, no console errors. Tests pass for forms/play and forms/react.
